protocol.scope: Supporting control extension on ten previously analyzed identification-confirmation fleets, not fresh independent control confirmation. No controller selection, retuning, refitting, additional acquisition, model clipping, fallback, or fleet replacement.
protocol.controller: Use frozen homogeneous A/B maps for identical LQI and steady yaw-rate prefilter. No OE affine offset or fitted initial state is inserted into the controller. NominalLTI uses exactly the saved 20 m/s acquisition gain/prefilter. RestrictedLocal extrapolates its saved three-function map across the full grid without nearest-speed fallback. Linear interpolation of gains and prefilter for the other methods. All start at beta=yaw=integral=steering=0.
protocol.plant_and_feedback: Saved nonlinear tanh-tire bicycle parameters, noise-free true-state feedback, prescribed speed, RK4 at 0.01 s with speed and steering held through each step. No sensor robustness or observer claim.
protocol.limits: Control stress-test limits inherited from experiment_10f: 12 deg steering, 120 deg/s rate, 6 deg sideslip. Acquisition used 30 deg/s. Integral clipped at 0.6 rad and conditional integration uses requested-versus-applied command. Recorded limiting is not itself infeasibility.
protocol.failure_policy: One failed design node makes the whole method-client schedule unavailable. Save failed cases for both maneuvers. Finite infeasible rollouts retain full RMSE. Numerical failure has no full-duration metric and is counted separately; never assign zero, silently drop, or repair. Complete execution means all cases recorded, not scientific success.
protocol.analysis_plan: Analyze after committed execution checkpoint. Report per-method/scenario synthesis failures, numerical failures, feasibility and limiting before tracking/effort. Summarize finite trajectories equally by client then fleet. Report paired fleet differences against NominalLTI, SmoothLocal and Global with explicit availability counts; no confirmatory p-values or selective complete-case victory claims. If a paired complete fleet set is unavailable, describe failures and conditional finite-trajectory metrics explicitly. ExactLPV is privileged, not a guaranteed lower bound. Frozen-speed radii are descriptive, not a time-varying stability certificate.
